cues: In PHP, plus always adds: the string five plus three is the number eight.
To join strings, PHP uses a dot.
JavaScript does the opposite: plus with a string joins.
And remember precedence: multiplication before addition, so two plus three times four is fourteen.
text: A trap when switching languages. In PHP, plus always adds: the string five plus three is the number eight. To join strings, PHP uses a dot. JavaScript does the opposite: plus with a string joins. And remember precedence: multiplication before addition, so two plus three times four is fourteen.
